document.summary: Matrix acceptance sign-off covering calibration checks, batch review responsibilities and the control-lot reference.

title_block.title: Matrix acceptance sign-off
title_block.subtitle: Bioanalytical QA, signed copy
lines: Prepared by: Helen Marchwood, Bioanalytical Quality Manager

blocks.p: This sign-off records the matrix acceptance rules that the bioanalysis group applies to tandem-MS runs from this date. It replaces the working note circulated in the spring and should be filed with the current assay worksheet template.

Each run carries a full calibration curve prepared in the matrix of the study samples. Curves are fitted with a weighted linear regression. A calibration point is only used if it back-calculates within the accepted window on the day of the run.

rows: Point excluded and curve refitted; the exclusion is written on the worksheet
Each batch, before the first standard
Batch held until the carry-over source is identified
Sample reanalysed; not corrected by arithmetic
Start, middle and end of each batch
Batch rejected and repeated if the run-level QC fails
table.caption: Table 1 Calibration and matrix checks applied to each run

blocks.p: Transition multiples are confirmed against the reference standard before each new analyte card is opened. Where two transitions disagree beyond the tolerance on the card, the quantitation transition is used and the discrepancy is noted in the analyst's comments.

The analyst prepares the batch and completes the first review. A second scientist, not involved in the run, checks the calibration, QC and internal standard data before the batch is released to the study director.

list: Analyst: batch preparation, first review, worksheet entries
Second reviewer: independent check of calibration and QC, signed on the worksheet
Mass-spectrometry manager: instrument status and any tuning changes
Study director: release of data to the study report, after matrix acceptance is recorded

blocks.p: Reviews are signed and dated on the worksheet in ink. Electronic reviews are accepted only where the LIMS audit trail is available for the same run.

Quality control samples are prepared from the control lot held in the matrix freezer. The lot reference on the worksheet must match the freezer log before the batch is started. A new control lot is only put into use after it has been checked against the outgoing lot in at least one run.
Correction to the control lot reference in the draft of this sign-off has been made by hand on the signed copy and is initialled below.
